questions.q: According to Hill, what are the two bases from which we build our lives?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says Hill saw faith and fear as the two foundations from which people operate.

questions.q: What is a drifter in the book?
a: Someone who does little thinking for themselves
Someone who travels without a plan
questions.why: Lesson 2 quotes the devil's definition: those who think for themselves never drift.

questions.q: What happens to drifting over time, according to Hill?
a: It becomes permanent through a hypnotic rhythm
It corrects itself naturally with age
It is cured by working harder
It only affects people who are lazy
questions.why: Lesson 2 says drifting turns into a hypnotic rhythm that keeps people busy with trivialities.

questions.q: Which principle means choosing a grand goal and pursuing it relentlessly?
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists definiteness of purpose first among the seven principles of freedom.

questions.q: What does Hill say about failure?
a: Failures only stop us if we let them
Failures should end a project immediately
Adversity is a sign of the wrong purpose
questions.why: Lesson 3 says failure is just failure; whether we learn from it or stop is our choice.
